checks.name: Strict typed goal boundary rejects accessors and extra authority fields
Actual SQLite goal binds exactly one admitted run
Identical create command is idempotent and cannot restart the run
Conflicting duplicate objective cannot overwrite a goal
Only one live goal is admitted per conversation
Stale revision is rejected before stop
Cross-conversation mutation cannot pause another goal
Pause commits before cancellation; late stop cannot overwrite pause
Cold initialization preserves pause and makes no implicit start
Explicit resume admits a fresh run and retains criteria
Only matching current run can enter and exit teacher waiting
Model report cannot write completion or arbitrary state
Current sanitized context and evidence come from main SQLite/tool facts
Plain-text boundary returns original Pi continuation and runnable current custom context
Provider error never forces continuation
Stopped owner cannot supply new context
Model review proposal alone cannot be accepted without durable result
All teacher criteria plus successful durable native run/result are required for completion
Completed goal cannot be revived by resume
Repeated report-only turns with no new effect stop as no progress without a running budget
Cold recovery interrupts active goal while completed result remains immutable
Goal schema migration is idempotent on the same real database
Actual production Pi session forces one original boundary continuation then runs real read and review tools with one native user
Cold ordinary chat preserves old native bytes while excluding goal custom context/tool and forced continuation

boundary: A: actual Electron SQLite/production controller/runtime; start/stop transport and native event are declared fixtures, no rendered UI or provider claim.
